reason: Strengthen the red line against lender discretion after signing.

proposed_change.old_text: Lender has absolute, unmediated discretion to refuse funding for any reason, even if the startup has fully complied with all contractual obligations.
proposed_change.new_text: Lender has sole-satisfaction, material-adverse-change, or unmediated discretion to refuse funding after the company satisfies objective contractual conditions.
